title: Mini Drills Dictation Lab Import Schema V1.1 (revision 1)
$comment: Rev1: angle brackets are allowed in plain-text fields (rendered inert by the UI; schema validation is NOT XSS protection). Pedagogical length thresholds are advisory; hard bounds are the schema maxima.
description: Structural validation only (stage 1). Semantic validation and teacher/audio verification are separate required stages. See dictation-schema-guide.md.

rawSpan.description: Half-open [start,end) offsets into rawTranscript.text, counted in UTF-16 code units.

cleanSpan.description: Half-open offsets into the cleanText of sentenceId.

spanRef.description: Exact occurrence reference into sentence.cleanText. occurrence is the 1-based rank of this match among whole-token, case-insensitive matches of surface in cleanText.

lengthException.description: Teacher-approved exception to an ADVISORY length threshold only. Never overrides hard bounds. approverRef is an optional opaque id; never invent identities.

officialClaim.description: Required for origin official_paper_transcribed and forbidden otherwise. A location-only Q marker is NOT an official claim.

source.description: Provenance of the listening material. Independent of importMode.

assetId.description: Opaque server-side asset id. URLs, paths and credentials are rejected by the pattern.

rawTranscript.description: Original supplied transcript. Never overwritten after import. sha256 is over the UTF-8 bytes of text.

turn.description: rawSpan covers the whole raw block including the speaker label.

qMarker.description: Detached annotation. Not spoken. Not automatically the full question text.

showTranscriptDuringTask.description: MVP invariant: the answer-bearing transcript is never shown during independent listening.

lessonLink.description: Opaque link metadata. Never student data, submissions or attempts.
